# `candid salary`

Salary intelligence database.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid salary [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `lookup` | Look up pay ranges for a company/title. |
| `import-lca` | Import DOL H-1B LCA disclosure data. |
| `parse-range` | Extract and store a pay range from JD text. |


### `candid salary lookup`

Look up pay ranges for a company/title.

```
usage: python -m candid salary lookup [-h] [--company COMPANY] [--title TITLE] [--location LOCATION] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--company` `COMPANY` | - |
| `--title` `TITLE` | - |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | - |
| `--json` | Print the raw lookup result as JSON (for scripting) |


### `candid salary import-lca`

Import DOL H-1B LCA disclosure data.

```
usage: python -m candid salary import-lca [-h] [--limit LIMIT] file
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `file` | (required) |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | - |


### `candid salary parse-range`

Extract and store a pay range from JD text.

```
usage: python -m candid salary parse-range [-h] --company COMPANY --role ROLE [--jd JD] [--text TEXT] [--location LOCATION]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--company` `COMPANY` | (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | (required) |
| `--jd` `JD` | - |
